title: Room Nine Is Open (La camera nove è aperta)

scenes.title: Quaranta limoni gialli
scenes.summary: Friday morning arrives, Tessa walks steadily on her rested ankle, and Hannah and Owen help squeeze forty fresh lemons for opening night.

scenes.title: Il gancio numero nove
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Graham screws a ninth brass hook onto the wooden key board and hangs the polished Room 9 key in its permanent home.

scenes.title: Ventiquattro sedie dopotutto
scenes.summary: At 5:45 PM, neighbors start streaming through the open gate early, proving Arthur's accidental twenty-four-chair order was exactly what they needed.

scenes.title: Tutto esaurito in quindici minuti
scenes.summary: Tessa, Hannah, and Owen race happily between kitchen and courtyard as nearly every slice of lemon tart sells out in fifteen minutes.

scenes.title: Il valzer del cortile è completo
scenes.summary: Inside the glowing glass sunroom, Evelyn introduces the completed thirty-year-old waltz and plays it to warm applause from the whole courtyard.

scenes.title: Un tavolo ogni venerdì
scenes.summary: Under the lanterns, Caleb tells Owen and Tessa he has rented a first-floor design studio on their street so he can move back to the city and share a Friday table with Owen every week.

scenes.title: Restare ancora
scenes.summary: As the last neighbors head home, Evelyn asks Hannah and Graham if she can stay two more weeks in Room 4 and play every Friday evening.

scenes.title: Sotto la terza pietra
scenes.summary: Closing the front desk for the night, Hannah, Graham, and Arthur read a thirtieth-anniversary May postcard mailed from abroad asking if the old tin capsule is still buried under the third stone from the courtyard tree.
